CAREERS

Work at Boreal.

Professional growth, continuous development and a structured environment for people who want to build a career in industry.

JOIN OUR TEAM

Developing people is part of the company’s growth.

At Boreal, we believe the company’s growth goes hand in hand with the development of every person who is part of our team.

Our work environment combines structure, professional development opportunities and benefits designed to support quality of life, safety and well-being.

BENEFITS

Structure to work, learn and grow.

01

Benefits and quality of life

Health insurance, pharmacy and gym partnerships, flu vaccination, on-site meals, free parking and a workplace stretching program.

02

Development

Boreal career development plan, free English classes during work hours, training, skills development and professional growth opportunities.

03

Leisure and team building

Employee social club, recreational area, soccer field, sand court, family leisure spaces, internal tournaments and team-building activities.
